verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Groq serves an llms.txt at console.groq.com/llms.txt that indexes its docs pages. Groq also serves agent-friendly markdown versions of its docs (overview.md returns HTTP 200, and many doc URLs end in .md), so an agent can be pointed at either. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting llms.txt and markdown docs for agent use, and independent or hands-on reports of agents consuming them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://console.groq.com/llms.txt # https://console.groq.com llms.txt
